bodies.name: Gargantua
bodies.temperature: The black hole has no planetary surface. The film depicts bright accretion gas outside it.
bodies.composition: A fictional spinning supermassive black hole, not a ball of rocky or gaseous material.
bodies.atmosphere: No planetary atmosphere; the surrounding accretion flow is separate from the black hole.
bodies.features: Interstellar's Gargantua. Kip Thorne's film-science interpretation uses about 100 million solar masses. The radius here is a rounded GM/c^2 drawing scale, not a measured horizon. No Kerr geodesics, gravitational lensing, accretion physics or time dilation are solved by this orbit map. Existing screensaver preferences are independent of this mod.
